name: cell-lct-macos
title_zh: 在打开的 Illustrator 里直接落科学图
tagline_zh: 画机制图、图形摘要到一半，想补个矢量元素？不用导出、不用拖拽、不用重画。它把 SVG 转成可编辑路径。
tagline_en: Mid-diagram and need one more vector piece? No export, no drag-drop, no redraw. It converts SVG to editable paths.
desc_en: Create or import editable scientific SVG figures into the user's currently open Adobe Illustrator document on macOS. Use for scientific diagrams, graphical abstracts, mechanism figures, reference-image vectorization, and appending vector artwork without replacing existing content. Requires macOS and Adobe Illustrator; do not use on Windows.
why_zh: 别的工具要你先把文件存好再导入；它直接接管 Illustrator 的当前文档。
why_en: Others force a save-and-import roundtrip; this one talks to the live document, decomposes SVG into editable paths, and never.
limit_zh: 只在 macOS + Adobe Illustrator 里生效，Windows 直接不可用。只认 SVG 输入。
limit_en: macOS + Adobe Illustrator only; no Windows. Accepts SVG only, no PNG/JPG. Output keeps paths and basic styles; complex gradients, filters, and masks.
title_en: Drop editable SVG figures into your open Illustrator doc
